evals.prompt: I just ran `npm install` and got an error: 'ERR! code ERESOLVE'. Log this error to the learnings system.
evals.expected_output: An error entry appended to .learnings/ERRORS.md with the correct format including ERR ID, timestamp, priority, status, summary, error details, context, and metadata.
expectations: Creates or appends to .learnings/ERRORS.md
The entry has an ID in the format ERR-YYYYMMDD-XXX
The entry includes a timestamp in ISO-8601 format
The entry includes a Priority field
The entry includes Status set to pending
The entry includes a Summary section describing the npm install failure
The entry includes the actual error message (ERESOLVE)
The entry includes a Context section with command details
The entry includes a Metadata section with Reproducible field

evals.prompt: Actually, you were wrong about that API endpoint - it uses POST not GET. The correct endpoint is POST /api/v2/users. Please log this correction.
evals.expected_output: A learning entry appended to .learnings/LEARNINGS.md with category 'correction', capturing the correct information.
expectations: Creates or appends to .learnings/LEARNINGS.md
The entry has an ID in the format LRN-YYYYMMDD-XXX
The entry uses the category 'correction'
The entry includes a Summary mentioning the API method correction
The entry includes Details explaining the change from GET to POST
The entry has Source set to 'user_feedback' or 'conversation'
The entry includes a Suggested Action for updating the code

evals.prompt: I wish you could automatically run our test suite before committing. Can you log this as a feature request?
evals.expected_output: A feature request entry appended to .learnings/FEATURE_REQUESTS.md with the correct format.
expectations: Creates or appends to .learnings/FEATURE_REQUESTS.md
The entry has an ID in the format FEAT-YYYYMMDD-XXX
The entry includes a Requested Capability section
The entry includes a User Context section explaining why auto-testing before commit is useful
The entry includes a Complexity Estimate
The entry includes a Suggested Implementation section
The entry includes Frequency in metadata

evals.prompt: We've had 3 similar errors with database connection timeouts this week. The learning LRN-20260320-001 already documents the first occurrence. Log this new occurrence and link it, and check if it should be promoted to CLAUDE.md.
evals.expected_output: A linked learning entry that references the existing entry, with bumped priority and a recommendation to promote to project memory.
expectations: Creates a new learning entry in .learnings/LEARNINGS.md
The entry includes a See Also reference to LRN-20260320-001
The entry has elevated priority (high or critical) due to recurrence
The entry mentions or recommends promotion to CLAUDE.md
The entry recognizes this is a recurring issue pattern

evals.prompt: I just discovered that our project uses pnpm workspaces, not npm. I kept trying npm install and it failed. This is important for anyone working on this project. Please log this and promote it to CLAUDE.md since it's broadly applicable.
evals.expected_output: A learning entry logged AND a corresponding addition to CLAUDE.md with a concise project convention.
expectations: Creates a learning entry in .learnings/LEARNINGS.md with category 'knowledge_gap' or 'best_practice'
The learning entry includes details about pnpm vs npm
Adds a concise rule or fact to CLAUDE.md about using pnpm
The learning entry status is set to 'promoted'
The learning entry includes a Promoted field referencing CLAUDE.md

evals.prompt: Review the current .learnings/ directory and give me a status check - how many pending items are there, any high priority ones?
evals.expected_output: A summary of pending learnings including counts and high-priority items.
expectations: Reads files from the .learnings/ directory
Reports the count of pending items
Identifies and lists any high-priority items
Provides actionable suggestions for next steps (resolve, promote, etc.)
